theorem_title: Logarithmic rate of the band divisor
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandDivisor_log_rate :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandDivisor n : ℝ) / Real.log n) atTop
      (𝓝 ((-_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.bandShift) * _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.epsilon)) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
As $n\to\infty$, the actual integer band divisor satisfies $$\frac{\log(\operatorname{bandDivisor}(n))}{\log n}\longrightarrow-\operatorname{bandShift}\,\varepsilon,$$ with the fixed schedule parameters shown.

This limit supplies the exact rounded divisor exponent when deriving the actual band-size and band-count rates.
